chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Varieties (of food) enlarge the belly and numb the buttocks.'
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of eating diverse foods according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links dietary variety to physical heaviness, a concept deeply rooted in classical Islamic medicine (Tibb) which views excessive diversification of food as disrupting the body's humoral balance. This teaching serves as a practical guideline for moderation, warning that while variety may be pleasurable, it can lead to lethargy and digestive sluggishness, thereby affecting spiritual alertness.
